data.title: Shell Company Address Concentration as Fraud Infrastructure Indicator
data.description: Detects abnormal concentration of corporate registrations at a single registered address as an indicator of shell company infrastructure used for fraud, money laundering, or beneficial ownership obfuscation. The ICIJ/OpenCorporates investigation of Wyoming documented that 40% of all Wyoming LLCs are registered to just two buildings in Sheridan, WY, with a 30% spike in LLC registrations in 2023 alone. Wyoming now surpasses Delaware in companies registered per capita. Wyoming LLC services are actively marketed in Cyprus, Singapore, and other offshore jurisdictions as tax avoidance and asset-shielding vehicles. Millions in PPP loan fraud were traced to shell companies registered at a single Wyoming storefront address. The Corporate Transparency Act beneficial ownership registry — catalyzed by the FinCEN Files investigation — was effectively gutted in 2025 when the Trump Administration suspended all enforcement and deleted previously submitted data, removing the primary countermeasure against shell company opacity in the United States. This rule targets the recon phase (P1) where fraud infrastructure is established through mass corporate registration at concentrated addresses.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_address_concentration AND (filter_opacity_jurisdiction OR filter_agent_velocity)

enrichment_required.source: OpenCorporates bulk data or state registry API — count of active entities currently registered at the same address
OpenCorporates bulk data or state registry API — count of new registrations by the same registered agent in the preceding 90 days
FinCEN BOI registry lookup — whether beneficial ownership information has been filed for this entity (NOTE status as of 2025 — enforcement suspended, data deleted)
OSINT — whether the registered agent or formation service is marketed in offshore jurisdictions (Cyprus, Singapore, UAE)

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Shell Company Address Concentration Detection
// Detects abnormal registration concentration at single addresses in opacity jurisdictions
entity_type IN ["LLC", "corporation", "limited_partnership"]
event_type="registration"
| groupBy(registered_address, function=[
    count(as=entity_count),
    count(distinct=entity_name, as=unique_entities),
    collect([entity_name, registration_date, registered_agent, registration_jurisdiction])
  ])
| entity_count >= 50
| registration_jurisdiction IN ["Wyoming", "Nevada", "Delaware", "South Dakota",
    "New Mexico", "BVI", "Seychelles", "Cayman Islands", "Panama"]
  OR agent_registrations_90d >= 10
| sort(entity_count, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Shell Company Address Concentration Detection")`
`comment("Detects abnormal corporate registration concentration at single addresses")`
index=flame_corporate sourcetype=flame:entity_monitoring
  (entity_type="LLC" OR entity_type="corporation" OR entity_type="limited_partnership")
  event_type="registration"
| stats count AS entity_count,
        dc(entity_name) AS unique_entities,
        values(registration_jurisdiction) AS jurisdictions,
        values(registered_agent) AS agents,
        min(registration_date) AS earliest_reg,
        max(registration_date) AS latest_reg
  BY registered_address
| where entity_count >= 50
| eval is_opacity_jurisdiction = if(
    match(jurisdictions, "Wyoming|Nevada|Delaware|South Dakota|New Mexico|BVI|Seychelles|Cayman|Panama"),
    1, 0)
| where is_opacity_jurisdiction=1
| sort - entity_count
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Shell Company Address Concentration Detection
-- Detects abnormal registration concentration at single addresses
SELECT
  e.registered_address,
  COUNT(*) AS entity_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.entity_name) AS unique_entities,
  e.registration_jurisdiction,
  e.registered_agent,
  MIN(e.registration_date) AS earliest_registration,
  MAX(e.registration_date) AS latest_registration,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN e.registration_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
        THEN 1 END) AS registrations_last_90d
FROM corporate_entities e
WHERE e.entity_type IN ('LLC', 'corporation', 'limited_partnership')
  AND e.entity_status = 'active'
GROUP BY e.registered_address, e.registration_jurisdiction, e.registered_agent
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
  AND (e.registration_jurisdiction IN ('Wyoming', 'Nevada', 'Delaware',
       'South Dakota', 'New Mexico', 'BVI', 'Seychelles', 'Cayman Islands', 'Panama')
    OR COUNT(CASE WHEN e.registration_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
             THEN 1 END) >= 10)
ORDER BY entity_count DESC

references: ICIJ/OpenCorporates Wyoming investigation — 40% of Wyoming LLCs at 2 Sheridan buildings
ICIJ/OpenCorporates, The Modern Money Trail Crypto & Cash webinar (2026)
OpenCorporates bulk data analysis methodology (PostgreSQL fuzzy address matching)
FinCEN Files investigation (2020) — catalyzed Corporate Transparency Act
Corporate Transparency Act — beneficial ownership reporting (enforcement suspended 2025)
PPP loan fraud traced to Wyoming shell company storefronts
falsepositives: Legitimate registered agent services (CT Corporation, CSC Global) that maintain large client portfolios at a single address
Coworking spaces and business incubators with many tenant companies
Law firm registered agent services with high-volume but legitimate client bases
